item.title: security: FORGE Lab uses agentic tools to identify memory safety issues in Rust
item.description:
Microsoft FORGE Lab reported memory-safety bugs in Rust’s core and std libraries, including cases where safe Rust code can lead to undefined behavior. The findings were made using Hyenas, FORGE’s research version of codename MDASH, and focused on three patterns of misplaced trust in unsafe code.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: commandline: Nine engineers, 1,211 pull requests in a day: Lessons from building Copilot Cowork
item.description:
Microsoft describes a case study from building Copilot Cowork, including a live migration of the runtime from Python to Rust. The article frames the migration as an example of the engineering practices used while shipping the system.

  • Source: Microsoft Command Line Blog

item.title: github: CodeQL 2.27.2 improves C++, Go, Rust, and JavaScript analysis
item.description:
CodeQL 2.27.2 is available with a new C++ regular-expression parser and analysis improvements for C++, Go, Rust, and JavaScript. The update applies to the static analysis engine used by GitHub code scanning.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: CodeQL 2.27.0 adds support for Linux ARM64
item.description:
CodeQL 2.27.0 is available on Linux ARM64. The release also adds a new Rust security query, expands framework coverage for Java/Kotlin and C#, and includes analysis accuracy improvements across multiple languages.

  • Source: GitHub
